definitions.explanation: A humble expression for listening to someone speak. Used when referring to listening to a respected person's speech, lecture, or music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝聴|はいちょう}⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I listened to your lecture (with respect).

examples.japanese: ⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧お⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝聴|はいちょう}⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{光栄|こうえい}→光栄：19436_kouei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It is an honor to be able to hear your valuable words.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝聴|はいちょう}⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I would like to hear your opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝聴|はいちょう}⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦いたしました→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by listening to the performance.

notes:
KEIGO (⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧): ⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧ (humble language). The prefix {拝|はい} indicates humble respect toward the speaker or performer.

FORMS:
- {拝聴|はいちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to listen - humble)
- {拝聴|はいちょう}⟦いたす→いたす：01314_itasu⟧ (more formal humble form)

CONTEXTS: Used when listening to lectures, speeches, sermons, concerts, or any situation where one listens to a respected person.

RELATED {拝|はい} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{拝見|はいけん}→拝見：02082_haiken⟧ (to see/look at - humble)
- ⟦{拝読|はいどく}→拝読：06280_haidoku⟧ (to read - humble)
- ⟦{拝借|はいしゃく}→拝借：06381_haishaku⟧ (to borrow - humble)

PLAIN EQUIVALENT: ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen - neutral)
